canonical_key: aaj jaane ki zid na karo
title: Aaj Jaane Ki Zid Na Karo
matla: Aaj jaane ki zid na karo, yoon hi pehloo mein baithe raho
matla_translation: Do not insist on leaving tonight; stay beside me just a little longer.
archival_note: Composed by Sohail Rana and immortalized by Farida Khanum in Raag Yaman Kalyan, turning a plea against parting into one of the subcontinent's most enduring nights.
yt_title: Aaj Jaane Ki Zid Na Karo ORIGINAL | Farida Khannum Ghazals Songs | Romantic Hindi Ghazal Songs

title: Ranjish Hi Sahi
matla: Ranjish hi sahi dil hi dukhane ke liye aa, aa phir se mujhe chhod ke jaane ke liye aa
matla_translation: Come even in bitterness, even to wound my heart; come if only to leave me once more.
archival_note: Mehdi Hassan's khayal-trained breathwork gives Ahmad Faraz's bruised longing an almost unbearable stillness.
yt_title: Ranjish Hi Sahi

title: Chitthi Na Koi Sandesh
matla: Chitthi na koi sandesh, jaane woh kaun sa desh jahan tum chale gaye
matla_translation: No letter, no word — to what distant land have you departed?
archival_note: Sung by Jagjit Singh in quiet grief after losing his son Vivek, giving every syllable the weight of personal bereavement.
yt_title: चिट्ठी ना कोई संदेश | Chithi Na Koi Sandesh - Lyrical Video | Jagjit Singh Ghazals | Old Ghazals

title: Chitthi Aayi Hai
matla: Chitthi aayi hai aayi hai chitthi aayi hai, bade dinon ke baad hum bewatanon ko yaad watan ki mitti aayi hai
matla_translation: A letter has arrived — after so many days, the scent of home's soil reaches us in exile.
archival_note: An anthem of diaspora longing that made Pankaj Udhas's velvet restraint a household voice across South Asia.
yt_title: Chitthi Aayi Hai | Pankaj Udhas | Naam 1986 Songs | Sanjay Dutt, Nutan, Amrita Singh

title: Ab Ke Hum Bichhde To
matla: Ab ke hum bichhde to shayad kabhi khwabon mein milein, jis tarah sookhe hue phool kitabon mein milein
matla_translation: If we part this time, we may meet only in dreams — like dried flowers pressed inside old books.
archival_note: Ahmad Faraz's pressed-flower image pairs with Mehdi Hassan's slow-unfolding melodic ascent.
yt_title: Ab Ke Hum Bichhde - Mehdi Hassan | Official Audio Song

canonical_key: woh jo hum mein tum mein
title: Woh Jo Hum Mein Tum Mein Qarar Tha
matla: Woh jo hum mein tum mein qarar tha, tumhein yaad ho ke na yaad ho
matla_translation: That quiet pledge between you and me — whether you remember it now or not.
archival_note: Begum Akhtar's unmistakable Lucknowi inflection turns Momin's 19th-century couplets into intimate conversation.
yt_title: Begum Akhtar - Woh jo humme tumme quarar tha

canonical_key: woh firaaq aur woh wisaal kahan
title: Woh Firaaq Aur Woh Wisaal Kahan
matla: Woh firaaq aur woh wisaal kahan, woh shab-o-roz-o-maah-o-saal kahan
matla_translation: Where now are those separations and reunions? Where are those nights, days, months, and years?
archival_note: Abida Parveen brings Sufi resonance to Ghalib's elegy for vanished passion.
yt_title: Woh Firaaq Aur Woh Visal Kahan with lyrics | वो फ़िराक़ और वो विसाल कहाँ | Jagjit Singh | Mirza Ghalib

canonical_key: hum tere shehar mein aaye hain
title: Hum Tere Shehar Mein Aaye Hain
matla: Hum tere shehar mein aaye hain musafir ki tarah, sirf ek baar mulaqat ka mauqa de de
matla_translation: I have entered your city like a passing traveler; grant me only a single meeting.
archival_note: Ghulam Ali's Patiala-gharana taans illuminate the ache of returning to a beloved's city as a stranger.
yt_title: Hum Tere Shahar Mein Aaye Hain

canonical_key: yaad nahin kya kya dekha tha
title: Yaad Nahin Kya Kya Dekha Tha
matla: Yaad nahin kya kya dekha tha saare manzar bhool gaye, uski galiyon se jab laute apna bhi ghar bhool gaye
matla_translation: I cannot recall what else I saw, all scenes faded; returning from your lane, I forgot my own home.
archival_note: Bashir Badr's quiet domestic imagery distilled into late-night acoustic clarity.
yt_title: याद नहीं क्या क्या देखा था - जगजीत सिंह गजल 'सहेर' एल्बम

title: Dhoondoge Agar Mulkon Mulkon
matla: Dhoondoge agar mulkon mulkon, milne ke nahin naayab hain hum
matla_translation: Search across countries if you will — you will not find another like us; we are rare.
archival_note: Shad Azimabadi's proud farewell sung with incandescent restraint.
yt_title: Dhondo Ge Agar Mulko | Abida Parveen | Eagle Stereo | HD Video

canonical_key: tere aane ki jab khabar mehke
title: Tere Aane Ki Jab Khabar Mehke
matla: Tere aane ki jab khabar mehke, teri khushboo se saara ghar mehke
matla_translation: When word of your coming drifts through the air, the entire house fills with your fragrance.
archival_note: Nida Fazli's sensory couplets float on an unhurried dadra rhythm.
yt_title: तेरे आने की जब खबर महके - जगजीत सिंह गजल 'सहेर' एल्बम

canonical_key: aye mohabbat tere anjaam pe rona
title: Aye Mohabbat Tere Anjaam Pe Rona Aaya
matla: Aye mohabbat tere anjaam pe rona aaya, jaane kyun aaj tere naam pe rona aaya
matla_translation: O love, I wept at what became of you; I know not why your very name brought tears tonight.
archival_note: Shakeel Badayuni's tragedy etched into history by Mallika-e-Ghazal Begum Akhtar.
yt_title: ऐ मोहब्बत तेरे अंजाम पे रोना आया | Begum Akhtar | Ae Mohabbat Tere Anjaam Pe Rona Aya | Sad Ghazal

canonical_key: zindagi jab bhi teri bazm mein
title: Zindagi Jab Bhi Teri Bazm Mein
matla: Zindagi jab bhi teri bazm mein laati hai humein, yeh zameen chaand se behtar nazar aati hai humein
matla_translation: Whenever life brings us into your gathering, this earth looks fairer to us than the moon.
archival_note: From Muzaffar Ali's Umrao Jaan, composed by Khayyam on Shahryar's timeless verse.
yt_title: Talat Aziz - Zindagi Jab Bhi Teri Bazm Mein Lati Hai Humain - Umrao Jaan

canonical_key: tum itna jo muskura rahe ho
title: Tum Itna Jo Muskura Rahe Ho
matla: Tum itna jo muskura rahe ho, kya gham hai jisko chhupa rahe ho
matla_translation: This smile you hold so bravely — what sorrow are you hiding beneath it?
archival_note: Kaifi Azmi's piercing observation of polite heartbreak, carried by Jagjit Singh's understated nylon-string guitar.
yt_title: तुम जो इतना मुस्कुरा रहे हो | जगजीत सिंह | अर्थ 1983 गीत | गजल गाने

canonical_key: baat niklegi to phir door talak
title: Baat Niklegi To Phir Door Talak Jayegi
matla: Baat niklegi to phir door talak jayegi, log bewajah udaasi ka sabab poochhenge
matla_translation: Once a word escapes, it will travel far; people will ask without reason why I seem so sad.
archival_note: From the landmark 1976 LP The Unforgettables that brought the modern acoustic ghazal to living rooms.
yt_title: Baat Niklegi To Phir Door Talak with lyrics | बात निकलेगी तो | Jagjit Singh | Duniya Jise Kahte Hain

canonical_key: aah ko chahiye ek umr asar
title: Aah Ko Chahiye Ek Umr Asar Hone Tak
matla: Aah ko chahiye ek umr asar hone tak, kaun jeeta hai teri zulf ke sar hone tak
matla_translation: A sigh takes a lifetime to take effect; who lives long enough to tame your flowing hair?
archival_note: Composed for Gulzar's television monograph Mirza Ghalib, pairing dry wit with fatalistic tenderness.
yt_title: Aah Ko Chaahiye Ik Umr Asar Hone Tak | Jagjit Singh Ghazal | Main Ghalib | Mirza Ghalib | Old Ghazal

title: Patta Patta Boota Boota
matla: Patta patta boota boota haal hamara jaane hai, jaane na jaane gul hi na jaane baagh to saara jaane hai
matla_translation: Every leaf and every sprig knows our condition; only the rose remains unaware, though the whole garden knows.
archival_note: Mir Taqi Mir's 18th-century complaint of unrequited devotion, elevated by Mehdi Hassan's phrasing.
yt_title: Mehdi Hassan - Patta Patta Boota Boota Ustad Tari khan

title: Mujhse Pehli Si Mohabbat
matla: Mujhse pehli si mohabbat mere mehboob na maang, maine samjha tha ke tu hai to darakhshan hai hayaat
matla_translation: Do not ask of me, my beloved, that first love again; I once believed life shone only because of you.
archival_note: Faiz himself famously said that once Noor Jehan sang this nazm-ghazal, it belonged to her more than to him.
yt_title: mujh se pehli si muhabbat mere mehboob.... madam noor jehan

title: Yeh Na Thi Hamari Qismat
matla: Yeh na thi hamari qismat ke wisaal-e-yaar hota, agar aur jeete rehte yahi intezaar hota
matla_translation: Union with the beloved was never our fate; had we lived longer, we would only have waited longer.
archival_note: Ghalib's classic reproach to destiny, sung by Begum Akhtar with crisp, ironic poise.
yt_title: Begum Akhtar - yeh na thi hamari qismat

title: Tere Khushboo Mein Base Khat
matla: Tere khushboo mein base khat main jalata kaise, pyaar mein doobe hue khat main jalata kaise
matla_translation: How could I burn letters steeped in your fragrance — letters drenched in love?
archival_note: Rajindernath Rahbar's portrait of a lover torn between wounded dignity and memory.
yt_title: Tere Khushboo Mein Base Khat | Jagjit Singh Ghazals | Sad Ghazals | Ghazal Collection | Old Ghazal

canonical_key: apni marzi se kahan apne safar
title: Apni Marzi Se Kahan Apne Safar Ke Hum Hain
matla: Apni marzi se kahan apne safar ke hum hain, rukh hawaon ka jidhar ka hai udhar ke hum hain
matla_translation: When did we ever steer our own journey? Wherever the winds turn, we belong there.
archival_note: Nida Fazli's quiet protest against fate and displacement.
yt_title: Apni marzi se kahan apne safar ke hum hain (Jagjit Singh)

title: Niklo Na Benaqab
matla: Niklo na benaqaab zamana kharaab hai, aur us pe yeh shabaab zamana kharaab hai
matla_translation: Do not step out unveiled — the times are unruly, and your radiance all the more disarming.
archival_note: Mumtaz Rashid's teasing admonition set to classic tabla-and-harmonium charm.
yt_title: Niklo Na Benaqab (Official Lyric Video) | Pankaj Udhas | Na-Yaab Vol. 1

title: Aur Ahista Kijiye Baatein
matla: Aur ahista kijiye baatein, dhadkanein koi sun raha hoga
matla_translation: Lower your voice a little more; someone may be listening to our heartbeats.
archival_note: Playful caution and hushed intimacy in Pankaj Udhas's signature late-nineties chamber sound.
yt_title: Pankaj Udhas - Ahista

title: Duniya Kisi Ke Pyaar Mein
matla: Duniya kisi ke pyaar mein jannat se kam nahin, ek dilruba hai dil mein jo hooron se kam nahin
matla_translation: In love, this world is no less than paradise — though love's trials spare no one.
archival_note: Mehdi Hassan's sweeping melody balancing devotion and quiet lament.
yt_title: Duniya Kisi Ke Pyar Mein

title: Apni Dhun Mein Rehta Hoon
matla: Apni dhun mein rehta hoon, main bhi tere jaisa hoon
matla_translation: I walk lost in my own melody — in quiet stubbornness, I am just like you.
archival_note: Nasir Kazmi's laconic Lahore modernism meets Ghulam Ali's classical elasticity.
yt_title: Apni Dhun Mein Rehta Hoon (Official Lyric Video) | Ghulam Ali | Live In India Vol. 2

canonical_key: ab ke tajdeed e wafa ka
title: Ab Ke Tajdeed-e-Wafa Ka
matla: Ab ke tajdeed-e-wafa ka nahin imkaan jaanaan, yaad kya tujhko dilayein tera paimaan jaanaan
matla_translation: There is little chance now of renewing our vow, beloved — why remind you of promises once made?
archival_note: Ahmad Faraz's dignified resignation voiced in Ghulam Ali's classical Patiala-gharana phrasing.
yt_title: GHULAM ALI - AB KE TAJDEED E WAFA KA NAHIN IMKAAN JANA

canonical_key: zindagi mein to sabhi pyar kiya
title: Zindagi Mein To Sabhi Pyar Kiya Karte Hain
matla: Zindagi mein to sabhi pyaar kiya karte hain, main to mar kar bhi meri jaan tujhe chahoonga
matla_translation: Everyone loves while alive; I shall love you, my dear, even beyond death.
archival_note: One of Mehdi Hassan's defining concert pieces, moving effortlessly from reproach to vow.
yt_title: Zindagi Mein To Sabhi Pyaar Kiya Karte Hain

title: Hoshwalon Ko Khabar Kya
matla: Hoshwalon ko khabar kya bekhudi kya cheez hai, ishq kije phir samajhiye zindagi kya cheez hai
matla_translation: What do the sober know of losing oneself? Fall in love, and only then understand what life is.
archival_note: Nida Fazli's luminous defense of love's unreason, set by Jatin-Lalit for Jagjit Singh.
yt_title: Hoshwalon Ko Khabar Kya | JAGJIT SINGH | Sarfarosh | 1999

title: Chupke Chupke Raat Din
matla: Chupke chupke raat din aansoo bahana yaad hai, humko ab tak aashiqi ka woh zamana yaad hai
matla_translation: I still remember weeping quietly night and day; I still remember that tender age of love.
archival_note: Maulana Hasrat Mohani's classic verse of secret courtship, performed by Ghulam Ali in Nikaah.
yt_title: Chupke Chupke Raat Din Aansoon Bahana Yaad Hai | Ghulam Ali Ghazals | Old ghazals | Sad Ghazals

canonical_key: tum ko dekha to yeh khayal
title: Tum Ko Dekha To Yeh Khayal Aaya
matla: Tum ko dekha to yeh khayal aaya, zindagi dhoop tum ghana saaya
matla_translation: Seeing you, this thought came to me: life is harsh sunlight, and you are deep shade.
archival_note: Javed Akhtar's tender metaphor of shelter, set by Kuldeep Singh in gentle conversational meter.
yt_title: Tum Ko Dekha To Yeh Khayal Aaya - Lyrical Video | Jagjit Singh Ghazals | Chitra Singh | Love Song

title: Hothon Se Chhu Lo Tum
matla: Hothon se chhu lo tum, mera geet amar kar do
matla_translation: Touch it with your lips, and make my song immortal.
archival_note: Composed by Jagjit Singh himself, stripping film orchestration back to voice, tabla, and warmth.
yt_title: HOTHON SE CHHU LO TUM - Jagjit Singh | Prem Geet

title: Jhuki Jhuki Si Nazar
matla: Jhuki jhuki si nazar beqaraar hai ke nahin, daba daba sa sahi dil mein pyaar hai ke nahin
matla_translation: That downcast gaze — is it restless or not? Even hidden deep, is there love in your heart or not?
archival_note: Kaifi Azmi captures the hesitation just before love confesses itself.
yt_title: झुकी झुकी सी नजर | जगजीत सिंह | अर्थ 1983 गीत | गजल गीत | शबाना आजमी, राज किरण

title: Gulon Mein Rang Bhare
matla: Gulon mein rang bhare baad-e-naubahaar chale, chale bhi aao ke gulshan ka kaarobaar chale
matla_translation: The spring breeze fills the blossoms with color; come now, so the garden may resume its life.
archival_note: Written by Faiz Ahmed Faiz in Montgomery Jail in 1954 and immortalized by Mehdi Hassan.
yt_title: Gulon Mein Rang Bhare

canonical_key: rafta rafta woh meri hasti ka
title: Rafta Rafta Woh Meri Hasti Ka Samaan Ho Gaye
matla: Rafta rafta woh meri hasti ka saamaan ho gaye, pehle jaan phir jaan-e-jaan phir jaan-e-jaanaan ho gaye
matla_translation: Little by little you became the whole measure of my being — first life, then soul of life, then beloved of the soul.
archival_note: An exquisite stair-step of devotion, delivered with Mehdi Hassan's trademark meend.
yt_title: Rafta Rafta Woh Meri Hasti Ka

title: Chandi Jaisa Rang Hai Tera
matla: Chaandi jaisa rang hai tera sone jaise baal, ek tu hi dhanwaan hai gori baaqi sab kangaal
matla_translation: Your radiance is silver, your hair like spun gold; you alone are wealthy, beloved, and the rest of us poor.
archival_note: Bright, affectionate admiration that became one of Pankaj Udhas's most requested mehfil staples.
yt_title: Chandi Jaisa Rang Hai Tera (Official Lyric Video) - Pankaj Udhas | Best Of Pankaj Udhas | Hindi Song

canonical_key: pyar ka pehla khat likhne mein
title: Pyar Ka Pehla Khat Likhne Mein
matla: Pyaar ka pehla khat likhne mein waqt to lagta hai, naye parindon ko udne mein waqt to lagta hai
matla_translation: Writing love's first letter takes time; fledgling birds need time before they take flight.
archival_note: Gentle patience for new love, set to warm acoustic harmonies.
yt_title: जगजीत सिंह- प्‍यार का पहला खत पूरा गीत- एल्‍बम फेस टू फेस

canonical_key: tum nahin gham nahin sharab nahin
title: Tum Nahin Gham Nahin Sharab Nahin
matla: Tum nahin gham nahin sharaab nahin, aisi tanhaai ka jawaab nahin
matla_translation: Neither you, nor sorrow, nor wine — there is no answer to a solitude like this.
archival_note: Saeed Rahi's spare, hypnotic couplets delivered with Jagjit Singh's unhurried poise.
yt_title: तुम नहीं गम नहीं शराब नहीं | Tum Nahin Gham Nahin Sharab Nahin | Jagjit Singh Ghazals | Old Ghazals

canonical_key: aap ko dekh kar dekhta reh
title: Aap Ko Dekh Kar Dekhta Reh Gaya
matla: Aap ko dekh kar dekhta reh gaya, kya kahoon aur kehne ko kya reh gaya
matla_translation: Looking upon you, I could only keep gazing; what more is left to say?
archival_note: Aziz Qaisi's awestruck simplicity carried by Jagjit Singh's effortless phrasing.
yt_title: Aap ko dekh kar dekhta rah gaya (Jagjit Singh)

canonical_key: dil mein ek lehar si uthi
title: Dil Mein Ek Lehar Si Uthi Hai Abhi
matla: Dil mein ek lehar si uthi hai abhi, koi taaza hawa chali hai abhi
matla_translation: A sudden wave has risen in the heart just now, as though a fresh breeze has begun to stir.
archival_note: Nasir Kazmi's delicate tremor of remembered tenderness, sung by Ghulam Ali.
yt_title: Dil Mein Ek Laher Si Uthi Hai Abhi | Ghulam Ali Ghazals | Old Ghazals | Sad Ghazals | Old Songs

canonical_key: kabhi kisi ko mukammal jahan nahin
title: Kabhi Kisi Ko Mukammal Jahan Nahin Milta
matla: Kabhi kisi ko mukammal jahaan nahin milta, kahin zameen to kahin aasmaan nahin milta
matla_translation: No one is ever handed a whole world; somewhere the earth is missing, somewhere the sky.
archival_note: Khayyam's composition and Bhupinder Singh's burnished bass-baritone give Nida Fazli's truth timeless gravitas.
yt_title: Bhupinder_Kabhi Kisi Ko Mukammal (Ahista Ahista; Khayyam, Nida Fazli; 1981)

canonical_key: aaina mujhse meri pehli si surat
title: Aaina Mujhse Meri Pehli Si Surat Maange
matla: Aaina mujhse meri pehli si surat maange, mere apne mere hone ki nishani maangein
matla_translation: The mirror asks me for the face I once wore; my own people ask for proof of who I am.
archival_note: Intimate reflective classicism from Talat Aziz's golden period.
yt_title: Aaina Mujhse Meri Pahli si Soorat by Talat Ajiz a heart touching song

canonical_key: ye tera ghar ye mera ghar
title: Ye Tera Ghar Ye Mera Ghar
matla: Ye tera ghar ye mera ghar, kisi ko dekhna ho gar, to pehle aake maang le teri nazar meri nazar
matla_translation: This house of yours and mine — whoever wishes to see it must first borrow your eyes and mine.
archival_note: Jagjit and Chitra Singh's duet captures domestic love with rare tenderness.
yt_title: Yeh Tera Ghar Yeh Mera Ghar with lyrics | यह तेरा घर यह मेरा घर के बोल | Jagjit Singh | Chitra Singh

canonical_key: main nazar se pee raha hoon
title: Main Nazar Se Pee Raha Hoon
matla: Main nazar se pee raha hoon, yeh samaa badal na jaaye
matla_translation: I am drinking through my gaze alone — let this moment never change.
archival_note: A beloved mehfil ghazal bridging devotion and gentle intoxication.
yt_title: Main Nazar Se Pee Raha Hoon (Album Version)

title: Woh Kaghaz Ki Kashti
matla: Yeh daulat bhi le lo, yeh shohrat bhi le lo, bhale chheen lo mujhse meri jawaani — magar mujhko lauta do bachpan ka saawan, woh kaghaz ki kashti, woh baarish ka paani
matla_translation: Take this wealth, take this renown, take even my youth — only return to me the monsoon of childhood, that paper boat, that rainwater.
archival_note: Sudarshan Faakir's elegy for lost innocence became the unofficial memory-song of an entire generation.
yt_title: Woh kagaz ki kashti woh barish ka paani Live HQ Sudarshan Fakir Jagjit Singh HiteshGhazal

title: Hazaaron Khwahishein Aisi
matla: Hazaaron khwahishein aisi ke har khwahish pe dam nikle, bahut nikle mere armaan lekin phir bhi kam nikle
matla_translation: A thousand desires, each worth dying for; many of my longings were fulfilled, yet still too few.
archival_note: Ghalib's quintessential meditation on human longing, set with hushed reverence.
yt_title: Hazaron Khwahishen Aisi | Lyrical | Jagjit Singh Ghazals | Old Ghazals | Sad Ghazals

canonical_key: yeh dil yeh pagal dil mera
title: Yeh Dil Yeh Pagal Dil Mera (Aawargi)
matla: Yeh dil yeh paagal dil mera kyun bujh gaya aawargi, is dasht mein ek shehar tha woh kya hua aawargi
matla_translation: Why has this restless heart of mine grown dim, O wandering? Once a city stood in this wilderness — what became of it?
archival_note: Mohsin Naqvi's nocturnal masterpiece, rendered by Ghulam Ali with haunting restraint.
yt_title: Yea Dil Yea Pagal Dil Mera  Ghulam Ali Live

canonical_key: shaam se aankh mein nami si
title: Shaam Se Aankh Mein Nami Si Hai
matla: Shaam se aankh mein nami si hai, aaj phir aap ki kami si hai
matla_translation: Since dusk there has been a quiet mist in my eyes; tonight again, your absence lingers.
archival_note: From Marasim, the celebrated collaboration between Gulzar and Jagjit Singh.
yt_title: Jagjit Singh, Gulzar - Shaam Se Aankh Mein Nami Si Hai

title: Kiska Chehra Ab Main Dekhoon
matla: Kiska chehra ab main dekhoon tera chehra dekh kar, meri aankhon ne chuna hai tujhko duniya dekh kar
matla_translation: Whose face could I look upon after seeing yours? My eyes chose you after beholding the entire world.
archival_note: Hushed, contemplative late-career Jagjit Singh at his most translucent.
yt_title: किसका चेहरा अब मैं देखुँ | जगजीत सिंह, अलका याग्निक | तरकीब 2000 | तबु

canonical_key: main khayal hoon kisi aur ka
title: Main Khayal Hoon Kisi Aur Ka
matla: Main khayal hoon kisi aur ka, mujhe sochta koi aur hai
matla_translation: I belong to someone else's reverie, yet it is another who thinks of me.
archival_note: Saleem Kausar's uncanny portrait of parallel solitude, sung with dark velvet gravity.
yt_title: Main Khayal Hun Kisi Aur Ka - Mehdi Hassan - 19 Min Version with Morning Raag.mp4

title: Dasht-e-Tanhai Mein
matla: Dasht-e-tanhai mein aye jaan-e-jahaan larzaan hain, teri aawaaz ke saaye tere hothon ke saraab
matla_translation: In the desert of solitude, O life of the world, tremble the shadows of your voice and the mirage of your lips.
archival_note: Iqbal Bano's regal voice renders Faiz's most luminous poem of night-time isolation.
yt_title: Iqbal Bano - Dasht e Tanhai Main Ae Jan e Jahan Larzan Hain

canonical_key: koi din gar zindagani aur hai
title: Koi Din Gar Zindagani Aur Hai
matla: Koi din gar zindagani aur hai, apne jee mein humne thaani aur hai
matla_translation: If a few days of life remain to me, I have quietly resolved something else within my heart.
archival_note: Composed by Jagjit Singh and sung by Vinod Sehgal for Gulzar's Mirza Ghalib.
yt_title: Koi din gar zindagani aur hai - Vinod Sehgal

canonical_key: aye jazba e dil gar main
title: Aye Jazba-e-Dil Gar Main Chahoon
matla: Aye jazba-e-dil gar main chahoon har cheez muqabil aa jaaye, manzil ke liye do gaam chaloon aur saamne manzil aa jaaye
matla_translation: O fervor of the heart, if I truly willed it, everything would draw near — I would walk two steps and the destination would meet me.
archival_note: Nayyara Noor's crystalline diction turns Behzad Lucknavi's spiritual longing into pure chamber poetry.
